description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Idigaspothana, Thalawa North D/S Division, Anuradhapura District (25/0313)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels, includes a detailed schedule of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and encumbrances, and is published under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements.
